title: Watchlists and Groups
description: The watchlists and instrument groups of the seed file (PRD FR-015), with the performance of their members and each group's equal-weighted performance.

list.name: watchlist

 WHERE kind = 'watchlist' AND enabled ORDER BY name

panels.title: Watchlist: ${watchlist}
panels.description: In list order, each provider's series on its own row. Returns in percent; rates and yields change in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.position AS "#",
        m.symbol AS "Symbol",
        m.instrument_name AS "Name",
        f.provider AS "Provider",
        f.day AS "Close of",
        f.close AS "Close",
        coalesce(f.currency, f.unit) AS "Unit",
        CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN 'pp' ELSE '%' END AS "In",
        max(CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.daily_change
                 ELSE f.daily_return * 100 END) AS "1 day",
        max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1w' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 week",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1m' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 month",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '3m' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "3 months",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = 'ytd' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "YTD",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1y' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 year"
   FROM v_instrument_list m
   LEFT JOIN v_performance f
     ON f.instrument_id = m.instrument_id
    AND f.observation_type = primary_observation_type(f.asset_type)
  WHERE m.list = ${watchlist:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY m.position, m.symbol, m.instrument_name, f.provider, f.day, f.close,
           f.currency, f.unit
  ORDER BY m.position, f.provider

panels.title: Watchlist relative performance
panels.description: Daily closes rebased to 100 at the first close in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "time", symbol || ' · ' || provider AS metric, rebased AS value
  FROM relative_performance(ARRAY(SELECT instrument_id FROM v_instrument_list WHERE list = ${watchlist:sqlstring}), $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
 WHERE rebased IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Group performance
panels.description: The average of the members' returns, each member weighted equally, with its main series from the provider with the most daily closes. Rates and yields are not averaged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title AS "Group",
       max(performance) FILTER (WHERE horizon = '1w') * 100 AS "1 week",
       max(performance) FILTER (WHERE horizon = '1m') * 100 AS "1 month",
       max(performance) FILTER (WHERE horizon = '3m') * 100 AS "3 months",
       max(performance) FILTER (WHERE horizon = 'ytd') * 100 AS "YTD",
       max(performance) FILTER (WHERE horizon = '1y') * 100 AS "1 year",
       max(members_with_value) FILTER (WHERE horizon = '1w')
           || ' of ' || max(members) AS "Members with a value (1 week)"
  FROM v_group_performance
 GROUP BY title
 ORDER BY title

panels.title: Group members: ${group}
panels.description: Each member's series from every provider, in percent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.symbol AS "Symbol",
        f.provider AS "Provider",
        f.close AS "Close",
        coalesce(f.currency, f.unit) AS "Unit",
        max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1w' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 week",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1m' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 month",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '3m' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "3 months",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = 'ytd' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "YTD",
max(CASE WHEN f.horizon = '1y' THEN CASE WHEN f.unit = 'percent' THEN f.performance ELSE f.performance * 100 END END) AS "1 year"
   FROM v_instrument_list m
   LEFT JOIN v_performance f
     ON f.instrument_id = m.instrument_id
    AND f.observation_type = primary_observation_type(f.asset_type)
  WHERE m.list = ${group:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY m.position, m.symbol, f.provider, f.close, f.currency, f.unit
  ORDER BY m.position, f.provider

panels.title: Watchlist freshness
panels.description: How current the values behind the watchlist are.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol AS "Symbol",
       provider AS "Provider",
       observation_type AS "Data",
       freshness AS "Freshness",
       observed_at AS "Latest value at",
       age_seconds AS "Age"
  FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE instrument_id IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM v_instrument_list WHERE list = ${watchlist:sqlstring})
   AND observation_type IN ('price', 'nav', 'rate', 'yield', 'index_level')
 ORDER BY symbol, provider
